description: This source file contains test classes for verifying the behavior of ADO.NET stream subscriptions across different relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL). It defines a base class 'AdoNetSubscriptionMultiplicityTests' with common setup and configuration, and derived classes for specific database implementations. The tests cover multiple subscription scenarios such as parallel, linear, add/remove, resubscription, and active subscription tests.
